tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You and your friend Alex have been discussing taking a vacation together during your university's spring break. You recently discovered a great travel package to a nearby city. You think this trip would be perfect for both of you. Write an email to Alex.
bullets: Explain why the travel package would be a fun vacation for both of you.
Invite Alex to book the trip with you.
tasks.subject: Exciting travel opportunity
